caption: The drawing features a rectangular section of fabric with a floral and ornamental design. The background of the fabric is off-white with subtle vertical stripes in a slightly darker beige tone. The main pattern consists of large, pink peony-like flowers with green and teal leaves, and smaller yellow and pink flowers with yellow centers. These flowers are interspersed with stylized, curved, abstract shapes in turquoise, yellow, pink, and brown, which resemble traditional Asian decorative motifs. There are also round, pink objects with stippled green outlines, possibly representing fruit or seeds, surrounded by spiky green foliage. Fine, pale ochre lines form a secondary pattern of loops and swirls throughout the fabric. The drawing is mounted on a plain, cream-colored background. At the bottom right, the artist's name "Henry Meyer" is written in small letters.
title: Chintz
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
